back: Hardware and software that carry out a task or control a process automatically, with little or no human involvement.
An output device that causes a physical action, e.g. motor, pump, valve, relay.
Sensor reads → ADC converts → microprocessor compares with stored values → signal to actuator if outside range → repeat continuously.
Converts the analogue signal from a sensor into digital data the microprocessor can process.
Faster reactions, works 24/7, accurate and consistent, safer for people, lower running costs.
Expensive to set up and maintain, sensor or software faults, job losses, hacking risk, cannot handle unexpected situations.
